topups.why: Grammatical, but three BUILD rows are already kept and they are stronger.
Sound, but five USE rows are already kept; it is the weakest because 느긋하게 쉬다 for ymlacio has no gloss.
'Sorry but he would be too busy today' has no condition to hang on and reads oddly; you would expect 'he'll be' (bydd).

originals.ko: 나는 그녀에게 네 질문에 대답할 시간을 주고 싶어
originals.why: The Welsh never contains the LEGO 'rhoi ateb' (to give an answer). It has rhoi + amser (give time) and ateb as a verb (to answer), so it does not practise this LEGO in the sense taught.

topups.why: Fine, but three BUILD rows are already kept.

topups.ko: 그래서 나는 오늘 답을 줄 필요가 있어

topups.why: 줬어 could also be answered with a simple past (mi wnes i roi / rhoddais i) instead of dw i wedi rhoi, so the Korean has two possible Welsh answers.
Grammatical, but four USE rows are already kept.
'Why do you want to give an answer now?' is an odd thing to ask; it is the weakest candidate.
